plan.scope: Fixed excluded syscall diagnostic; four attempts, no best-run selection or timing comparison.
plan.driver_delta: Exact shared committed driver, including non-executable data identity classification and detach immediately after fixed grace before post-window file verification.
plan.capture_window: Attach after 1000-request UDP prewarm; 1000 warmup+4000 measured client completions then fixed1s grace. Same boundary for both implementations.
plan.tree_scope: Trace parent and every fork with -f; bind all PID ancestry and original image mappings; nonempty children at fixed grace invalidates completeness.
plan.priority_affinity: driver enters loopback-only network namespace; daemon nice10 CPU2; upstream CPU1; loadgen CPU3.

previous_pre_capture_failure.reason: strict file mapping set treated read-only TZif data as a DSO; no prewarm, tracer, or load launched

scope: One fixed exact-image C/E UDP-hit and TCP-hit syscall matrix; no timing acceptance.

scope.scope:
Oracle-only excluded perf diagnostic of exact SDK ELF owner hot paths.

Runs inside a fresh loopback-only netns. It preserves frozen DNS workloads,
but perf-instrumented elapsed time is never an acceptance measurement.
scope.process_tree: root and every inherited fork; no --no-inherit
scope.counter_window: 1000 warmup + 4000 measurement completions, then fixed 1s drain; prewarm excluded

accounting.scope: Entered/completed calls for the captured owned process tree; 5000 client queries plus fixed grace, not pure steady per-query cost.
limitations: strace elapsed time is not compared.
vDSO clock calls are invisible to syscall tracing.
Ancillary flags and buffers are observed; user-space cmsg parsing instructions are not.
Parameters are counted on completed calls; in-flight boundary calls are listed separately.
